note: The baseline column of docs/METRICS.md. Every number carries the section it came from and the sample it was measured on, because several of them are sample-dependent and one of them is mislabelled (see metric 2).

outputParseability.why: a property of @babel/generator, not of the decompiler: a valid @babel/types AST cannot print as invalid JavaScript. BASELINE_AUDIT.md 2.5

opcodeCaseCoverage.why: counts `case` labels in legacy/src/dataflow.js, not correct reconstruction: JumpLoop is handled and every loop is still lost. BASELINE_AUDIT.md 4.6
